name: Jin
source:
“Yes, it’s fine if you hate me. Being liked would be revolting.”

A high-ranking figure of the Demon Nation who serves Demon King Gardis.

Despite his gentle outward appearance, he is dark and calculating within.

He would do anything for Gardis, and if necessary, would trample upon the heroine’s dignity without hesitation.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/sr/sien/]the official website[/url].]
